note: Which alarm went off. Every alarm that goes up (a garrison's or a crowd's) shows `toast` with the place it belongs to, its first letter made a capital: an outpost or village by its location label, the cruiser and the station by name, the town's by the town's generated name in `places` (%s). `unnamed`: the same places on a world that names no town or station. Generic, in-world, no franchise terms.

places.station_remnant: the Remnant deck on the station %s
places.station_guards: the guards' deck on the station %s

unnamed.station_remnant: the Remnant deck on the station
unnamed.station_guards: the guards' deck on the station
